- **Cavaliers Shopping Schroder:** The Cleveland Cavaliers are actively trying to trade Dennis Schroder to free up salary cap space for their new draft picks. [Trade rumors](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_)
- **World Cup Boosts Xiaohongshu:** The social media platform Xiaohongshu gained significant traction during the World Cup, challenging Hupu's traditional dominance in sports discussions. [Analysis](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxObmxic2JuWGVTblRYN25GR0pISnY0ZTc2Vlh4Qk1zaERyai1xN0dHaVI3UUdhWGtJM3RMai1iTjIxcUFoLURzTU5rT2M5UmVsX284Z1ROX2V0TWM4UmZLcmppT0JNUEg2QWFSeDM1V0luYUN1azZ5Tk9NX3g3RzdhRnRYVkRaUDhtN0tvdw)

Hupu's community remains divided, with some embracing Xiaohongshu's rise while others defend the forum's unique user culture.

羽毛球.zh:
2026年中国羽毛球公开赛今日在常州奥体中心开拍，国羽全主力出击，男单石宇奇、女单陈雨菲领衔卫冕征程。首日赛程包括年轻组合朱一珺等登场，世界羽联超级1000赛事为奥运积分关键战。中国队志在主场捍卫荣誉。

- [2026中国羽毛球公开赛前瞻：国羽全主力主场出击](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxNQWdTaEdzUmNkUmpxSzgyclhLTl91UG5DOXFQRFhFWEllc2FOU1E5Nndxbk1ET0liQUxvTjhPdUJ3bW5GejZESE5hOGJHWThWbWZSeFBtazZuVGhNakFvem1NbXc3OWRpTUljQW1sZzByUDBPNUtWQ0UtSWQwVVdJNEN3NA)
- [首日赛程：朱一珺等亮相](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE04WUlWdXhrUEFhMnU1XzhXSEtBeTdJbTlNODRNdWdrWVBDdlBScHFpb3J4eUV6VTJ2TVp4OHhlSmYxdU1tdERaakhCTlJ5NFI4YXlhb3ZVU1JOaEFOQWh6eG1COA)
- [中国公开赛综合信息](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9UVnhva2FlUUZEN2lxVm5pbHVGMThKaS02Z3llQVFEUkRDcmhnTVZjcmhCOHRUUUNnYzVINGZJS25hbFI0WHJIdUtpT0tZWjhMWEJkc0VwUHJYT3lneWdJdm1yVQ)

收束：石宇奇、陈雨菲等主力状态正佳，主场作战能否卫冕将直接影响年终总决赛席位，值得密切关注。
羽毛球.en:
The 2026 China Badminton Open is set to begin at the Changzhou Olympic Centre, with China fielding a full-strength squad including defending champions Shi Yuqi (men's singles) and Chen Yufei (women's singles). The tournament is a key event for Chinese badminton as they aim to dominate on home soil.

- **Tournament Preview:** The China Badminton Open will feature top Chinese players, with Shi Yuqi and Chen Yufei leading the charge to defend their titles. [Full preview on Olympics.com](https://olympics.com/en/news/2026-china-badminton-open-preview)
- **Schedule Released:** First-day matchups have been announced, including fixtures for rising star Zhu Yijun alongside the established stars. [Schedule](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE04WUlWdXhrUEFhMnU1XzhXSEtBeTdJbTlNODRNdWdrWVBDdlBScHFpb3J4eUV6VTJ2TVp4OHhlSmYxdU1tdERaakhCTlJ5NFI4YXlhb3ZVU1JOaEFOQWh6eG1COA)
- **China's Full Squad:** The Chinese national team has entered its strongest lineup, aiming to secure multiple titles in front of the home crowd. [Squad details](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9UVnhva2FlUUZEN2lxVm5pbHVGMThKaS02Z3llQVFEUkRDcmhnTVZjcmhCOHRUUUNnYzVINGZJS25hbFI0WHJIdUtpT0tZWjhMWEJkc0VwUHJYT3lneWdJdm1yVQ)

Home-court advantage and strong form make China the favorite, but international challengers will be eager to disrupt.

篮球.zh:
前CBA状元区俊炫正式加盟NBL香港金牛，他在社交媒体表示“为球队争取每一场胜利”。区俊炫2020年以状元身份进入CBA，此番转战NBL寻求新突破。同时，山东男篮功勋外援杰特退役后致力于守护中国年轻球员追梦NBA，跨越山海搭建桥梁。

- [前CBA状元区俊炫加盟NBL香港金牛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxNRUxGTU1jZmZwWFZ6UTNkT1JqQWF0eHpCNEJfXzUycEFEX3dFZWM0YnZJWmZycTJBVF9tSnFLdmtuc3VrZ1JUd2daaVBJWFMtSlpFRm03UndsT3hzcllxQ2pJUXI1aGFOZk9jU3RyTmxSaEtOZmw5MHluYTd5YjRadGhROFk1aDVVV25fTVRMNGQzNFRYQ1VuRVgtMm42M1hWQzRtQg)
- [杰特：守护中国年轻球员追梦NBA](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNVFBCemtWaDFGb2FhNFJXaFRENFRRT1pjM0I3M1NQOThMcGdKMzJJbzdmc1FKQ3hlY196T2ZNOHZCMTBSWHRwMUhEN0NDaUpLLXFzdXRiNjUzUkQ0Q0tzVEJza25ySUNPZDd5TDRHeGJMdldEVldNbGt2OWx0bmlCMnZR)

收束：区俊炫的转会反映了CBA球员流动新趋势，而杰特的坚守则凸显中美篮球交流的温情一面，中国篮球人才通道正在多元化。
篮球.en:
Chinese basketball saw two notable developments: former CBA No.1 pick Qu Junxuan has officially joined NBL team Hong Kong Bulls, while former Shandong foreign player Jet has committed to mentoring Chinese young players aiming for the NBA. These moves highlight growing pathways for Chinese talent.

- **Qu Junxuan Joins Hong Kong Bulls:** The former CBA top draft pick signed with the NBL's Hong Kong Bulls, stating he will fight for every victory for the team. [Transfer news](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxNRUxGTU1jZmZwWFZ6UTNkT1JqQWF0eHpCNEJfXzUycEFEX3dFZWM0YnZJWmZycTJBVF9tSnFLdmtuc3VrZ1JUd2daaVBJWFMtSlpFRm03UndsT3hzcllxQ2pJUXI1aGFOZk9jU3RyTmxSaEtOZmw5MHluYTd5YjRadGhROFk1aDVVV25fTVRMNGQzNFRYQ1VuRVgtMm42M1hWQzRtQg)
- **Jet's Mentorship Role:** Former Shandong foreign player (known as Jet) is now dedicated to helping Chinese young players pursue NBA dreams, crossing borders to provide guidance. [Mentorship story](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNVFBCemtWaDFGb2FhNFJXaFRENFRRT1pjM0I3M1NQOThMcGdKMzJJbzdmc1FKQ3hlY196T2ZNOHZCMTBSWHRwMUhEN0NDaUpLLXFzdXRiNjUzUkQ0Q0tzVEJza25ySUNPZDd5TDRHeGJMdldEVldNbGt2OWx0bmlCMnZR)

These moves signal a growing ecosystem for Chinese basketball talent beyond the CBA.

日韩.zh: 今日日韩娱乐的关键词是“入伍”与“出新”。李准英（[Lee Jun Young Enlists In The Military](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856186wpp/lee-jun-young-enlists-in-the-military)）于7月21日以现役身份入伍，郭东延（[Kwak Dong Yeon Announces Military Enlistment Date](https://www.soompi.com/article/1856144wpp/kwak-dong-yeon-announces-military-enlistment-date)）则确认8月25日服役，两名男星的缺席将影响其后续影视项目排期。与此同时，tvN新剧《四手双奏曲》公开张圭悧（Jang Gyuri）角色剧照，饰演宋康的童年好友兼音乐天才，钢琴题材的青春罗曼史值得期待。Mnet恐怖综艺《SUMBAKKOKJIL 2》公布首位参赛者Cortis，K-pop偶像捉迷藏生存战热度延续。2026 K-World Dream Awards公布表演阵容（ATEEZ、RIIZE等），10周年意义非凡。此外，印度演员R. Madhavan警告国内电影业正失去Gen Z观众给动漫，这一观点虽来自南亚，但折射出亚洲流行文化版图中“韩流vs日漫”的竞争格局。收束：军白期叠加新剧轮动，下半年韩流内容供给或出现短期缺口，但综艺与颁奖典礼仍维持热度。

欧美.zh: 欧美娱乐界消息密集，聚焦三大事件：**票房**——克里斯托弗·诺兰的《奥德赛》全球开画2.63亿美元，创其个人最佳，其中海外1.4亿、北美1.23亿，而周星驰《功夫足球》重映累计2.14亿美元、《玩具总动员5》逼近10亿（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/box-office-global-odyssey-kung-fu-soccer-hope-toy-story-5-1236998978/)）。**争议**——Ed Harris公开指责派拉蒙剧集《Dutton Ranch》误导他的角色重要性，称拍到一半就想“滚蛋”（[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/ed-harris-misled-dutton-ranch-paramount-taylor-sheridan-1236816999/)）；Offset因袭击大麻店保安被判50小时社区服务，需完成愤怒管理课程（[Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/offset-medmen-dispensary-assault-case-community-service-1235596373/)）。**离别与传承**——《终结者》系列编剧William H. Wisher Jr.去世，享年71岁（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/william-h-wisher-jr-dead-the-terminator-screenwriter-1236999019/)）；《今夜秀》与《大卫·莱特曼秀》制作人Peter Lassally逝世，享年93岁（[Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/peter-lassally-dead-johnny-carson-david-letterman-1236652771/)）。此外，Chloe Fineman宣布离开《SNL》（[THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/chloe-fineman-opens-up-decision-leave-snl-the-dink-1236652821/)），Mara Wilson称《玛蒂尔达》续集“有可能”（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/mara-wilson-matilda-sequel-possible-1236999026/)）。收束：经典IP与个人品牌冲突并存，头部内容依旧吸金，但幕后创作分歧与艺人法律问题正在重塑行业信任。
欧美.en: A mix of box office milestones, celebrity interviews, and obituaries dominated Western entertainment news. Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' soared globally, while Jon Stewart and Ed Harris made headlines for candid remarks. - [‘The Odyssey’ Rules Global Box Office With $263.7M Opening](https://deadline.com/2026/07/box-office-global-odyssey-kung-fu-soccer-hope-toy-story-5-1236998978/) — Nolan's epic sets personal records; 'Toy Story 5' nears $1B. - [Jon Stewart on World Cup Final Halftime Show](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/jon-stewart-world-cup-final-halftime-show-trump-1236817023/) — Called it the 'Reverse Super Bowl' with Spanish on field, English halftime. - [Ed Harris Felt ‘Misled’ by ‘Dutton Ranch’ Role](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/ed-harris-misled-dutton-ranch-paramount-taylor-sheridan-1236816999/) — Actor expressed frustration about being promised a larger part in Yellowstone spinoff. - [Adam Driver Has Passed on So Many Marvel Roles, Kevin Feige Says](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/adam-driver-passing-marvel-roles-tradition-kevin-feige-1236652800/) — Feige calls it a 'tradition' to Zoom with Driver who then declines. - [William H. Wisher Jr. Dies at 71](https://deadline.com/2026/07/william-h-wisher-jr-dead-the-terminator-screenwriter-1236999019/) — Co-writer of 'The Terminator' and 'Terminator 2' passed away peacefully. - [Brad Paisley Recalls Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s Wedding](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/brad-paisley-taylor-swift-travis-kelce-wedding-1235596400/) — Described 'cat-and-mouse' details at Madison Square Garden ceremony. - [Offset Gets 50 Hours Community Service for Assault](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/offset-medmen-dispensary-assault-case-community-service-1235596373/) — Rapper also ordered anger management and firearm restrictions. The industry is absorbing the loss of two influential screen and TV figures, while box office and celebrity controversies keep the narrative dynamic.

中国.zh: 中国娱乐板块今日多线交织。**悼念**——资深演员谢贤因肺炎于7月16日去世，家人遵遗愿低调告别（[中国娱乐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1oeXU0TjI4V2phRlJZOVB0Vmp0Z2lkc0RSRkRTWHppY0ZVTXdaaE82LURqUFQ4VWYxUkVtNlJacmx4RDhmMjdYeHNpVnM1RUJWZ2tLUzN2RG9fR28)），其传奇演艺生涯画上句号。**婚变**——余文乐宣布离婚（[华人头条](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE02VG9rNUI3cFB1MTFBaEFhbGF3eFQ2S3hmeG51cnI1S1FmUjFOSXRnSGRURVJrcHphMzlIcU5QRzRLR1YtZHRkRVhDaS15UzlqTGNSNEdYSUhsUC1SZFE)），港星婚姻稳定性再受审视。**文化出海**——外国观众因C-Drama爱上中式习俗，如红糖水等细节引发热议（[搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNVVJoRlhES0dzMUJCTVcxbGJHZ3Q4c1p4bERJbVRhQmtkQ1htR0d4bkV2bU4xbmItMmwyOG1RVEFtb2tLbW9YSTZlcDF1TUU5TkxRWmJUaWQwMFdXMk9YMEJSOUlDODFDalZhNEwzVW9EcDdlRWpFQllHQnp3M0pMZ2FqQlV5bVBR)）；影视飓风则陷入“员工陪老板演松弛感”争议，本人回应“我是中国人而自豪”（[驱动之家](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE4wZXAyNGhxMWpNbHhFWU5oeFZwLWZWUlZIWVU3MEFTTXNKTnFBSnp2MDhPYXh2dm0wTHFwWi0xSHY0eG5SS3Vod2RYeDdmcUtsUVh0U0xEbzg)）。此外，世界杯决赛中国明星参与（汤姆·克鲁斯等）成为娱乐热点，庄法回国后越南反应也被关注。收束：本土文化细节的国际传播与行业内部舆论危机并存，中国娱乐圈正在双线推进“出海”与“内省”。
中国.en: The Chinese entertainment sector was shaped by a high-profile death, a celebrity divorce, and ongoing discussions about cultural exports. - [谢贤7月16日因肺炎去世](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1oeXU0TjI4V2phRlJZOVB0Vmp0Z2lkc0RSRkRTWHppY0ZVTXdaaE82LURqUFQ4VWYxUkVtNlJacmx4RDhmMjdYeHNpVnM1RUJWZ2tLUzN2RG9fR28) — Veteran actor Xie Xian passed away on July 16; family held a low-key funeral per his wishes. - [余文乐宣布离婚](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE02VG9rNUI3cFB1MTFBaEFhbGF3eFQ2S3hmeG51cnI1S1FmUjFOSXRnSGRURVJrcHphMzlIcU5QRzRLR1YtZHRkRVhDaS15UzlqTGNSNEdYSUhsUC1SZFE) — Hong Kong actor Shawn Yue announced his divorce. - [当外国观众爱上C-Drama，哪些“中式习俗”被反复讨论？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNVVJoRlhES0dzMUJCTVcxbGJHZ3Q4c1p4bERJbVRhQmtkQ1htR0d4bkV2bU4xbmItMmwyOG1RVEFtb2tLbW9YSTZlcDF1TUU5TkxRWmJUaWQwMFdXMk9YMEJSOUlDODFDalZhNEwzVW9EcDdlRWpFQllHQnp3M0pMZ2FqQlV5bVBR) — Foreign audiences are discussing Chinese customs seen in C-Dramas, boosting cultural soft power. - [影视飓风回应被恶意解读](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNQi1hN1c0cVZ5Zk9jYThGeHBhSmFNZ0E0YUNfM3BWRGJ4bFltWmU5blFwNkEtdmZxVnhsMW9udmFrQ0pVNmVvalctOTNmMkRvSVdSR28wVFk1Qk9iVW5udE1NM1dZbXl4QXk5LW1SNmdMdE1UbmR6MlBCYkNqbkU0RlZPeXpXSUlFUnNRMDlwSE9wRXpPVjFFOQ) — Tech influencer 'Film Storm' refuted malicious interpretations about employee culture. - [世界杯决赛群星云集！中国明星、海外名流荟萃](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5UZzFYVEVjMkl3ZENSdURoSTR4Rl9tZWhvUDR2X2JpMFExOS1neXRKNjdoT3BvTS1vNWN2b0c2MUxFWnlXV1FkTER2ZmM3R2Ntckh1Rm1FWGFYdmJvR1k1R2hR) — World Cup final attracted many Chinese celebrities, highlighting cross-border entertainment ties. The death of Xie Xian marks the end of an era for Hong Kong cinema, while the growing international appeal of C-Drama signals a shift in global pop culture.

微博社区动态.zh: 微博今日热搜被**阿根廷决赛争议**霸榜。西班牙夺冠颁奖时阿根廷全队背过身，决赛犯规25次、本届世界杯犯规超100次创纪录，#阿根廷 脏#话题引爆争论（[网易](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5scmZqeGVxLURoaTNmWlF4MlRHbjhiTHMwRjVTVndVS19MY2d4MDRUZUdqaThOSkJBTjdrUEQyVzZwcUViOUtEbmswQkVDaHNmVWMtQmpfU2ZCSTFEVktYcXNR)）。随后苏醒、薛之谦力挺梅西，登顶微博热搜（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE44MUR4ZlFrTjVxOEIyM0h1dFhLUzlsdmVjaEN2dHVVODBNbFRZMnUzb244Y3p2QnM0T25mVldZX3dJTEU0c3lTZDl4RTRnbUJwQU9LcDFZN2pNMVBBRVpXZktPd2NJbmplblVKMEdwVWo)）。另一条热点是张凌赫新剧带火老艺人考古潮（[新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOZU4xZ3JwNjZqcUtmV3hFQURTU0R4UWhMcVpGaDFIUWFhcGVBMFJyRzRFYmZWVk1taFpGX2NRYzhYSzBBZE9xSXYtVldNWWxRTDVlZWIzSTNDSndhclVzQW5ZR0VLeGh6bnhFQ09CZmVmNEtwb053R3RTaVd6ZTZQa3JwTndvOE54WEVHY1lHMTB0VUtyV2FPN0RObnpmNHhncVp2T2FjdURudw)），年轻演员带动经典作品二次传播。收束：体育与娱乐的深度绑定在微博生态中愈发显著，粉丝情绪化表达成为流量引擎，需警惕极端对立升级。
微博社区动态.en: Weibo buzzed with three major topics: a viral trend linking actor Zhang Linghe to revived interest in older celebrities, heated debate over Argentina's sportsmanship in the World Cup final, and celebrity support for Lionel Messi. - [张凌赫真能“旺”老艺人？新剧考古潮引热议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOZU4xZ3JwNjZqcUtmV3hFQURTU0R4UWhMcVpGaDFIUWFhcGVBMFJyRzRFYmZWVk1taFpGX2NRYzhYSzBBZE9xSXYtVldNWWxRTDVlZWIzSTNDSndhclVzQW5ZR0VLeGh6bnhFQ09CZmVmNEtwb053R3RTaVd6ZTZQa3JwTndvOE54WEVHY1lHMTB0VUtyV2FPN0RObnpmNHhncVp2T2FjdURudw) — Discussion about Zhang Linghe's supposed effect of boosting older co-stars' fame. - [“西班牙领奖时，阿根廷全队背过身”，热搜第一！](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5scmZqeGVxLURoaTNmWlF4MlRHbjhiTHMwRjVTVndVS19MY2d4MDRUZUdqaThOSkJBTjdrUEQyVzZwcUViOUtEbmswQkVDaHNmVWMtQmpfU2ZCSTFEVktYcXNR) — Argentina's team turned their backs during Spain's victory ceremony, sparking #阿根廷脏 trending. - [力挺偶像，“苏醒薛之谦为梅西发声”登顶微博热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE44MUR4ZlFrTjVxOEIyM0h1dFhLUzlsdmVjaEN2dHVVODBNbFRZMnUzb244Y3p2QnM0T25mVldZX3dJTEU0c3lTZDl4RTRnbUJwQU9LcDFZN2pNMVBBRVpXZktPd2NJbmplblVKMEdwVWo) — Chinese singers Su Xing and Xue Zhiqian publicly defended Messi after the final, topping the trending list. The Weibo community remains intensely engaged with both domestic entertainment drama and global sports controversies, demonstrating the platform's role as a real-time cultural barometer.
